prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t pick one single “best” company for everyone — the best choice depends on your neighborhood, whether it’s a home or business, how quickly you need service, your budget, and any brand/warranty requirements. If you tell me your zip code and whether this is residential or commercial (and whether you need same‑day emergency service), I’ll pull a short list of top local HVAC companies and compare them.

Meanwhile, here’s how to quickly find the right AC repair company in Houston and what to look for:

What to check
- License and insurance: Verify the Texas HVAC license (TACLA number) and liability insurance.
- Certifications: NATE certification and manufacturer certifications (Carrier, Trane, Lennox) are a plus.
- Reviews and reputation: Look at recent Google, Yelp, and BBB reviews — focus on recent repair jobs and responsiveness.
- Transparent estimates: Get a written estimate that lists parts, labor, trip fees, and diagnostics separately.
- Warranties and guarantees: Ask about parts & labor warranties and any satisfaction guarantees.
- Experience with your system: Confirm experience with your AC brand and system type (split, package, heat pump).
- Availability: Ask about emergency/same‑day service and typical response times.
- Pricing model: Flat-rate vs time-and-materials — get clarity before work begins.
- Maintenance plans: If you’ll need ongoing service, compare maintenance plans and cost savings.

How I can help right now
- Give me your zip code (or neighborhood) and whether it’s a home or business and I’ll list 3–5 highly rated local Houston HVAC companies, with quick pros/cons and contact notes.
- If you need emergency help now, say “emergency” and your zip and I’ll prioritize companies offering same‑day service.

Which would you like me to do?
